description: A Carrier attaches photo-of-delivery.heic to its Proof of delivery. APIM answers 202, the TMS refuses the file by its content with FileNotAccepted and the message is dead-lettered. Known answer: the file type is refused, the cause is in the Carrier's file, so resubmitting the same message would fail again.

setup.seed: Send a Carrier Proof of delivery while it is on. Set EVALUATION_CORRELATION_ID to the correlation ID of that Message trail.

input: Explain why the Message trail ${EVALUATION_CORRELATION_ID} failed, and what the Integration operator could do about it.

explanation.rubric: Says the TMS refused a file of the Proof of delivery because of its type or content (a HEIC photo, not accepted). Does not say the TMS was down or that a retry or a resubmit of the same message would help.
